bifrost: springboard/audiod (audio service, proto springboard/proto/src/svc.rs), springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs, springboard/src/shell/music/system.rs, springboard/src/shell/music/nowplaying.rs, springboard/src/shell/control_center.rs, springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs (audio client), springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (floating player)
summary: The shell publishes whatever the audio service plays to the lock screen Now Playing card and the Control Center media controls, with play, previous, next, seek and shuffle/repeat state. Apps have no Now Playing API: there is no local MediaSession publish, no typed content or artwork model, no feedback or playback-rate commands, and no remote-device sessions.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs (shell as audio service client); no app-facing publish API in springboard/sdk/src/
features.note: Only the shell reads playback; an app cannot register its own session. The audio client (springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87) drives playback but does not publish metadata to the system.

features.feature: Publishing media sessions to Lock Screen and Control Center
features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/music/system.rs (lock-screen card, Control Center controls); springboard/src/shell/notify/mod.rs (card placement above the notification list)
features.note: Works for whatever the audio service holds, not for an app's own session. The Music app is the only source; other apps reach the card only by playing through the service.

features.feature: Remote sessions: RemoteMediaSession, extension, attributes, MediaDevice
features.apple: RemoteMediaSessionRepresentable, RemoteMediaSession, RemoteMediaSessionExtension, RemoteMediaSessionExtensionConfiguration, RemoteMediaSessionAttributes, RemoteMediaSessionError, MediaDevice
features.bifrost: springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs:250 and springboard/src/media/route.rs:34 (route name only, for the Now Playing route label)
features.note: No remote playback across devices, no extension point, no device list. The Bluetooth route is displayed, not controlled as a remote session.

features.feature: Content types and metadata (MusicContent, PodcastContent, MovieContent, TVShowContent, BookContent, RadioContent, GenericContent, MediaType, MediaDuration)
features.apple: MediaContentRepresentable, MusicContent, PodcastContent, MovieContent, TVShowContent, BookContent, RadioContent, HomeMediaContent, GenericContent, MediaType, MediaDuration
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-now-playing, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The service track carries no title, artist, kind or artwork fields, so the card cannot receive typed metadata from an app. Duration is in the snapshot (duration_ms) and live streams have a Live marker.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/music/nowplaying.rs:218 (LockCard, LOCK_ART_PT geometry); springboard/apps/music-desktop/src/music.rs (art drawn by the Music app)
features.note: The lock card has an artwork slot, but no artwork crosses the audio service and no size or animated representation is offered to apps.

features.feature: Play, pause, stop and toggle commands
features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (Cmd::Play, Pause, Toggle, Stop); springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs:152 (svc_transport); springboard/src/shell/control_center.rs (transport buttons)
features.note: Transport works from the lock card and Control Center. Apps have no command registration, so a remote command from the system cannot be routed to an app's own player.
Works for the service queue. Enablement per command is not published, so the card cannot grey out an unavailable direction.

features.feature: Skip forward and backward by interval
features.note: Wave 3 (w3-now-playing, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The lock card and Control Center only offer track skips. The floating player widget takes skip symbols from the app, but nothing sends an interval skip to the service.

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (Cmd::SeekMs); springboard/src/shell/audiosvc.rs:168 (Target::Scrubber hit test); springboard/sdk/src/widgets.rs (PlayerLayout.progress seek)
features.note: Absolute seek works through the lock card scrubber and the floating player progress track. Press-and-hold fast forward and rewind (begin and end actions) is not implemented.

Wave 3 (w3-now-playing, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The audio service has no playback-rate command or field in its snapshot.

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (Cmd::SetShuffle, Cmd::SetRepeat, enum Repeat Off/All/One, Snapshot.shuffle and repeat)
features.note: The service stores and changes both modes. The lock card and Control Center do not expose a shuffle or repeat control, so the system surface cannot change them.

Wave 3 (theme-03, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No feedback command exists in the service or the shell cards.

features.bifrost: springboard/proto/src/svc.rs (Snapshot: playing, position_ms, duration_ms, shuffle, repeat, queue_len, volume, muted, error, live); springboard/sdk/src/lib.rs:87 (audio::Client subscription)
features.note: Apps can subscribe to the service snapshot through the audio client. The snapshot is the service's own state, not a Now Playing snapshot an app publishes, and it has no rate field.

gaps: No app-facing local media session: an app cannot publish its own metadata, state and commands to the lock screen or Control Center (MediaSession, MediaSessionRepresentable).
No typed content model: the service track has no title, artist, kind, or artwork, so the lock card cannot show metadata from apps other than Music.
No artwork transport or animated artwork through the audio service.
No remote media sessions across devices, no remote session extension and no device list; the Bluetooth route is only shown as a name.
No interval skip commands and no press-and-hold fast forward or rewind through the system surface.
No playback-rate command or field in the audio service.
Shuffle and repeat are stored in the service but are not offered on the lock card or Control Center.
